sloka: स भूतले भीमबलाभिपिष्टः सुरारिभिस्तैरभिहन्यमानः।जगाम खं वेगवदभ्युपेत्य पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम ।। ६.६७.८९ ।।
transliteration: sa bhūtale bhīmabalābhipiṣṭaḥ surāribhistairabhihanyamānaḥ।jagāma khaṁ vegavadabhyupetya punaśca rāmeṇa samājagāma ।। 6.67.89 ।।

translations.english: Deprived of ears and nose by Sugriva, splitting with nails and teeth, Kumbhakarna was highly furious and pinning down Sugriva pounded him against the ground, limbs bespattered.
